title: PDF to DOCX & Markdown Converter
description: Converts the text layer of a PDF into a Markdown file and a DOCX file: column-aware reading order recovered by a band-first recursive XY-cut (full-width horizontal bands first, aligned table rows detected before any column split, then vertical gutters flanked by real text columns on both sides), font-size heading tiers plus all-caps section headings, paragraphs with end-of-line hyphens rejoined, bulleted and numbered lists, and best-effort tables. Detects and reports pages with no text layer, and flags pages whose text runs reach the right page boundary, instead of shipping silent clipping or empty output. Entirely client-side, zero network calls, pdf.js inlined workerless.

pdf_file.description: A text-layer PDF file, chosen or dropped in the browser

mcp_tool_definition.description: Extracts the text layer of a PDF and converts it to Markdown and DOCX, with column-aware reading order (band-first recursive XY-cut with table detection before column splits), font-size-based heading detection plus all-caps section headings, bullet/ordinal list detection, and best-effort tables. Reports pages with no text layer rather than returning silent empty output, and flags pages whose text runs reach the right page boundary inline in both outputs. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/643-pdf-to-docx-markdown-converter.html for interactive use.
